summary: Bearish tape: the S&P was about -0.9% at noon ET and the 10-year pushed back above 5% after hot October CPI, with Fed's Waller flagging a likely December hike and Nvidia still the biggest drag. Changes: kept the same six picks, nudged SPY and QQQ levels lower for the deeper selloff and trimmed AMD and TTWO confidence; quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from search snippets and index moves.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Day two of selling on the board probe into Huang; Monday's 170.24 low caps it and losing 165.50 opens the 164.27 52-week low (price estimated).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P extended to about -0.9% as the 10-year topped 5% and December hike odds near 90-99%; under 743.50 continues the slide (price estimated from the index).

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Long-duration tech hit hardest by 5% yields plus the Nvidia drag; under 666 targets the 661 area (price estimated).

picks.name: Rocket Lab
picks.reason: Wider Q3 loss and Neutron delay to 2027 in a risk-off, high-yield tape; breaking Monday's 53.01 low extends the selloff (no fresh quote, price estimated).

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Rotation out of Nvidia after Oppenheimer's upgrade keeps it above Monday's 508.58 close, but rising yields cap it; reclaiming 525 resumes the trend, under 508.50 fails (price estimated).

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Holding its post-earnings gap on GTA VI preorders before the Nov 19 launch, though the weak tape limits upside; over 219.50 extends (no fresh quote, price estimated).
